scope: Directed movement in the ux-directed-movement worktree; no Xiara or M4 actions

safetyContract.manualRefresh: A second manual MOVE in the same direction extends its lease without a stop; a new manual action preempts Jev, follow, and cycle.
safetyContract.directedWalk: A GUID is sampled once. A coordinate must have one native ground height matching its Z within 0.25 yards. The daemon checks initial ground, forward and reverse ground continuity, and collision rays at each step of at most 0.5 yards. It caps the direct leg at the smaller of requested yards and sampled horizontal separation. The 10-second safety lease renews only during progress. Unsafe ground, correction, disconnect, HALT, and takeover stop it with a reason.
safetyContract.outcomeAuthority: A completed pose is local prediction, not server-confirmed arrival. A stopped result exits the CLI with code 1.

wrongFloor.method: Repeat the point command with destination Z raised 10 yards

halt.method: Send HALT over another IPC socket after observing MSG_MOVE_START_FORWARD for an active walk
